szoveg_eredeti:
Perplexity is the industry leader that defined what a company built around multi-model orchestration could look like. Today, we’re launching our Orchestrator API, that picks the right model for your task: balancing across capability, capacity and latency, and, giving you the flexibility to choose across 45+ open-weight and closed models.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Perplexity (@perplexity_ai); megjelent: 2026-11-17T20:13:20+00:00; link: https://x.com/perplexity_ai/status/2122785177135096053; média: videó, 30 másodperc]
Introducing the Perplexity Orchestrator API.

Orchestrator lets you choose the right model for the right task, and automatically selects the provider based on availability, capacity, and latency.

All open-weight and proprietary models are in one API with unified billing.
